<?xml version="1.0" encoding="utf-8"?>
<package xmlns="http://schemas.microsoft.com/packaging/2012/06/nuspec.xsd">
  <metadata>
    <id>Gravicode.RLNet</id>
    <version>0.1.0</version>
    <title>RLNet - Reinforcement Learning for .NET</title>
    <authors>Kang Fadhil (Gravicode Studios)</authors>
    <license type="expression">MIT</license>
    <licenseUrl>https://licenses.nuget.org/MIT</licenseUrl>
    <readme>README.md</readme>
    <projectUrl>https://github.com/DotNetVibeCoderz/Vibe_Library/tree/main/RLNet</projectUrl>
    <description>Dependency-free reinforcement learning library for .NET 10. Gym-style environments, a SIMD neural-network engine, and prebuilt DQN, A2C, PPO, SAC and TD3 agents with multi-agent support. Dibuat oleh Gravicode Studios, dipimpin oleh Kang Fadhil.</description>
    <releaseNotes>First release: Gym-style environment API with Discrete/Box spaces, seeded determinism and truncation; SIMD MLP engine with Adam; DQN (double + dueling + prioritised replay), A2C, PPO, SAC, TD3; nine environments across classic control, robotics, finance, supply chain and multi-agent.</releaseNotes>
    <copyright>Copyright (c) 2026 Gravicode Studios. Dibuat oleh Gravicode Studios, dipimpin oleh Kang Fadhil.</copyright>
    <tags>reinforcement-learning rl machine-learning ai dqn ppo sac td3 a2c q-learning gym multi-agent neural-network simd</tags>
    <repository type="git" url="https://github.com/DotNetVibeCoderz/Vibe_Library/tree/main/RLNet" commit="3662e64d237c05d8ab574045dea5b0af103d0477" />
    <dependencies>
      <group targetFramework="net10.0" />
    </dependencies>
  </metadata>
</package>
